svg.text: Governed Agentic SDLC — From Ticket to Merge
Human supervisor · orchestrator · stage agents · always-on governance · CI and human gates on private repositories
keeps authority over scope, design and merge
Decomposes the goal, assigns stage agents
routes feedback and retries between stages
Reads ticket, Jira / Confluence docs and
the repo; drafts scope and impacted files
ReAct loop over git, IDE and build tools;
outputs a patch / draft pull request
cases traced back to the requirement
Lint, pytest and security scan run on
every push of the draft pull request
on the central repository before merge
to the ticket; ticket updated and closed
cannot merge or push to main
audit trail and escalated to a human
Phase 1 reads left → right. Phase 2 continues right → left, so every CI, check or review failure loops back to the Code Agent (Step 3) by the shortest path.
